review_evidence: README states the mathematical goal: basic theory of sums of squares in rings and fields, ultimately toward real closure.
SumSq/Defs.lean and SumSq/List.lean define sum-of-squares constructions and prove permutation/append compatibility; Exercises also defines formal variants.
Top-level Lean files contain additional typed constructions and proofs rather than generated reports, so no exact primary exclusion is justified.
summary: Retain SumsOfSquares: the package develops sums-of-squares mathematics together with supporting formal examples and type-theoretic experiments.
